review_scope.final_render: Opened all ten contact sheets: every 0.5-second sample, first/last frames, cut boundary minus one/current/plus one frames.
review_scope.additional: Opened original K08 retained handoff interval's all 42 frames; K09 retained departure interval at 0.125-second spacing; full-resolution caption/action frames at 13.5, 27.5, 29.5 and 31.5 seconds.

story_and_edits: 0-2.5 seconds: one charger picked up and put into right pocket, pink phone stays on desk.
2.5-11.75: sentimental farewell contrasted with colleague's applied and personally checked shared AI method. Post text carries the meaning; tiny blank phone screen is not presented as readable UI.
11.75-17.25: repaired K04 take02 completes boarding with suitcase, no return to pavement.
17.25-22.25: external incoming-call badge avoids false UI on phone back; man lifts phone to ear and looks toward door.
22.25-27.5: actual disembarkation completes; black phone is stowed before next cut. Question appears 1.25 seconds before charger reveal.
27.5-29.5: K07 take02 begins after charger is already held in right hand. Wrong-side pocket retrieval is omitted with PD approval.
29.5-31.25: real moving handoff insert from K08 take01 source1.5-3.25, crop330/215/810/485. All42frames show receipt and giver release; earlier phone disappearance excluded.
31.25-34.25: K09 take02 source3.5-6.5 shows already departing bus rear receding into the street, followed by empty road. Initial open-door movement and axis instability omitted.
34.25-39: colleague leaves, man remains with suitcase; 39-44 five-second event card.
known_limitations: K07 pocket retrieval and K09 door closing/departure start are not proven successful actions; they are intentionally omitted through cuts.

K08 right-hand receipt differs from planned left-hand continuity; the close-up implies intervening offscreen phone handling. This is an editorial compromise, not a claim of physically corrected source.
K08 enlarged crop is softer than surrounding wide footage; charger bundle arrangement also varies slightly between takes.
Actual real-time continuous playback and subjective listening were not verified. Numerical audio QA is not listening.
